relogin.title: Sign out and sign back in
relogin.body: You were added to the docker group, which takes effect at your next sign-in. After you sign back in and open Atomic Chat, the installation continues by itself.
relogin.stillWaiting: Already signed out and back in, and still waiting here? Restart the computer: a session that stays running in the background (a remote login, or services kept alive after sign-out) can keep your old groups.

remove.title: Remove TensorRT-LLM?
remove.body: The engine image, its caches and the installation are deleted. Docker, the NVIDIA Container Toolkit and the docker group stay on this computer.
